messages.author: ea6b1cd9e71466ee
messages.subject: No data received (Shiny Server)
parts:
Hi,

I'm getting an error for one of my apps on shiny-server:

When I first start shiny-server, the app loads and works fine. However, after a few uses by myself or possibly some other users, it starts to just hang on open and after about 2 minutes Chrome gives me the "No data received" page. 

I can tell it's not an issue with Shiny Server because another app in the same directory is working just fine. 

Has anyone experienced this? I've been combing through my code trying to come up with anything that might be causing it but I have no idea. I realize that I may have to post my code to get help on this but I wanted to throw it out there in case anyone knows right away what it might be.

Some other info: Some of the things that are unique to this not-working app are my sourcing of some other R files with functions in them, and just a more complex app structure overall.

messages.author: ea6b1cd9e71466ee
messages.subject: Re: No data received (Shiny Server)
parts:
To add on to this - Is there anything I should be aware of that happens when multiple users are accessing the app at the same time? How is the server.r code executed in these cases? I'm wondering because it's apparently hanging before anything displays in the app at all, which indicates to me that it's the initial few lines (prior to "shinyserver(function(...") that's screwing it up.

The only lines I have up there are :

library(shiny)
baseExt <<- "/.../"

# Data frame with penetration info
load(paste(baseExt,"getPenEnv.RData",sep = ''))

# Functions
source(...)
source(...)

messages.author: ea6b1cd9e71466ee
messages.subject: Re: No data received (Shiny Server)
parts:
I've figured out what was going wrong so hopefully this will help someone in the future: 

I had "rv <<- reactiveValues(...)" which made rv a global variable. Because of that, every time a second user opened the app, it would change the save 'rv' variable and start an infinite loop. 

Good talk everyone, glad we could work through this.
